name: Rahul Patil
text: The idol looks premium and very well finished. Packaging was secure and delivery on time.

name: Neha Kulkarni
text: Loved the detailing and traditional touch. Would definitely recommend to friends and family.

name: Amit Deshmukh
text: Good quality and craftsmanship. The size was slightly smaller than expected but overall satisfied.

name: Pooja Nair
text: Very elegant design and smooth finish. It enhanced the beauty of our living room.

name: Rohit Verma
text: Nicely crafted statue with good attention to detail. Delivery was prompt.

name: Sneha Joshi
text: Authentic look and premium feel. Perfect choice for festive decoration.

name: Kunal Mehta
text: Product quality is good, though I expected a bit more weight. Still looks amazing.

name: Shweta Pawar
text: Excellent craftsmanship and finishing. Everyone who visited our home loved it.

name: Vikas Malhotra
text: Very good traditional artwork with modern appeal. Value for money.

name: Anjali Singh
text: Beautifully designed and carefully packed. A great addition to our prayer room.
